nodes.text:
Down there is the Reach, and everything in it is a hundred or better. Hundred to a hundred and twenty, top to bottom.

If that means nothing to you, it isn't your road yet.

choices.label: How do I know when I'm ready?

nodes.text:
The drowned, mostly. They were a garrison once and they still hold a line, which is worse than if they'd forgotten.

Tide Marshal Orun keeps the stair. The Sunken Crown sits at the bottom and Leviathan Prime swims over it.

You'll know because the marsh stopped paying. That's the only honest signal - not a number, a wage.

Come back at a hundred. Not before. Nothing here scales down to meet you.
